messages:
Nia: Quick cheeky question: if you could stash one secret snack in the office that everyone would find but no one could trace back to you, what would it be? No judgment, hypothetical heists only. :eyes:
Owen: Tiny jars of Nutella hidden behind the printer. Instant hero.
Harper: A box of those fancy mini churros. Not stealthy but worth the risk.
Jules: Single-serve Marmite tubes. Controversial, very British, high-lounge-value.
Nia: ha! @finley-bot, can you run a silly poll?
finley-bot: Poll created: "Secret Snack to Stash"  Options: Nutella Jars / Mini Churros / Marmite Tubes / Mystery Candy Bag / Other
Owen: Vote cast: Nutella Jars :chocolate_bar:
Harper: Vote cast: Mini Churros :doughnut:
Jules: Vote cast: Marmite Tubes :flag_gb:
Sam: Vote cast: Mystery Candy Bag :candy:
Nia: Voted Other ("A stack of perfectly ripe bananas 10/10 potassium")
Owen: If Nutella wins I will hide the jars and make a dramatic rescue plan.
Harper: If churros win, I will brave the downtown food truck at lunch and smuggle a box back.
Jules: Marmite requires a tiny note that says: "You either love it or you run."
Sam: Mystery Candy Bag is basically a blind trust for sugar. Could be lifesaver or chaos.
Nia: Plan: whoever's snack wins gets to leave a tiny sticky note signature (first name + tiny doodle) next to the stash. Legacy matters.
finley-bot: Reminder set: sticker signature supply run on Friday at 3pm.
Owen: Also: if anyone actually finds the stash and eats it, return policy is zero refunds.
Harper: Deal. Also offering to be the official stash-keeper if we need a designated smuggler.
Nia: Thanks team! Will post poll results and coordinate the first clandestine drop. Also anyone who voted Other owes a fun backstory about the choice.
Jules: I will write a Marmite origin myth."
